'''Rick Erpelding''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 1999 Glenview tournament]] on 5 December 1999 with Dark Aliens (Cloud City, no S&V), according to Jonathan Morse's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d137">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-glenview-il-12-5-99d137/ glenview-il-12-5-99], DeckTech (Jonathan "Soma" Morse, 6 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-glenview-il-12-5-99d137/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
